name: briefing_runtime_destructor
description: HudUiBriefingRuntime::Destructor disables the runtime, resets locators, destroys message entries and briefing panels, tears down transport progress and action queue nodes, and destroys the background base.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited by explicit MSVC destructor EH registration/state scaffolding and the decompiler's circular-list boolean idiom; assembly and MLIL validate the cleanup order.

The native smoke constructs the current C++ briefing runtime subobject graph, covers non-empty message entries and action queue teardown, verifies locator-panel destruction, and keeps non-null background image/video resource branches covered by accepted direct callees.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x403ed0 validates compiler runtime dispatch-table evidence, HudUiBackground::SetEnabled(0), array-destroying six locator panels via HudUiElement::ResetCommonFTable, clearing the message entry vector, destroying panels in reverse construction order, destroying transport progress, unlinking and deleting all action queue nodes from the sentinel tail, deleting the sentinel, clearing action queue fields, and finally calling HudUiBackground::Destructor.

The native smoke initializes real briefing runtime subobjects, two composite message entries, six locator panels, and a two-node circular action queue, then validates locator vptr reset, vector clearing, action queue clearing, transport-progress cleanup, and background-base disable.
